crossRefs.note: Then I said to the angel who talked with me, “Where are these carrying the ephah basket?”
But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’
The measuring line will go out further straight onward to the hill Gareb, and will turn toward Goah.

He who spoke with me had for a measure a golden reed to measure the city, its gates, and its walls.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Then I asked, “Where are you going?” He said to me, “To measure Jerusalem, to see what is its width and what is its length.”
translations.bsb: “Where are you going?” I asked. “To measure Jerusalem,” he replied, “and to determine its width and length.”
translations.kjv: Then said I, Whither goest thou? And he said unto me, To measure Jerusalem, to see what is the breadth thereof, and what is the length
translations.asv: Then said I, Whither goest thou? And he said unto me, To measure Jerusalem, to see what is the breadth thereof, and what is the length thereof.
